metadata.notes: JSON-compatible YAML so the project does not require PyYAML.
metadata.scientific_question: Does evolutionary code search provide performance gains above and beyond base LLM coding strength, or is most performance variance explained by the underlying model?

model_tiers.notes: Older nano coding-capable tier used as the deliberately weak budget-feasible baseline. Replace the score with a verified HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, or SWE-bench value only if a comparable public score is confirmed for all three tiers.
Newer nano coding-capable tier used as the medium budget-feasible ladder point.
Budget-feasible stronger coding-capable tier used for the factorial disentanglement. This replaces gpt-5.5 to keep the paid campaign affordable while preserving a weak/medium/strong model ladder.
